pkgmetadata.longdescription:
TFLint is a Terraform linter focused on finding possible errors (like invalid instance types), warning about deprecated syntax and unused declarations, and enforcing best practices and naming conventions.
This package installs upstream's prebuilt binary release rather than building from source. app-admin/tflint (::guru) builds from source but requires a maintainer-provided Go module vendor tarball hosted outside of upstream infrastructure; that host has gone stale on repeated occasions, leaving the ebuild unbuildable for extended periods (bugs.gentoo.org/969525).
